scene_prompt: A cozy retro kitchen at sunset in a colorful 1930s rubberhose cartoon style, warm golden light coming through a window on the left, clean playful composition with strong readable shapes and soft vintage textures. In the center, a small round turquoise table with a red-and-white checkered cloth holds exactly 3 yellow lemons in a blue bowl, 1 open newspaper, and a tiny silver spoon near the edge. Behind the table is a mint-green refrigerator with 2 small magnets shaped like stars and 1 paper grocery bag resting on top. On the right side, a smiling cream-colored toaster sits on a wooden counter beside exactly 2 slices of bread and a small jar of strawberry jam with the lid open. Above the counter hangs a wall clock showing 5:20. A black-and-white cat sleeps on a striped orange rug near the bottom left corner. Near the window are 4 small potted plants lined up on the sill. A copper pan hangs from a hook beside the window. On the floor near the fridge is a pair of blue slippers slightly apart from each other. Bright but warm vintage cartoon palette, subtle film grain, soft shadows, clean framing, no text, no logos, no interface elements.
